moments.title: Value Date (earliest auto-selected; cutoff displayed, e.g. 'Payment…
moments.customer_action: Value Date (earliest auto-selected; cutoff displayed, e.g. 'Payment must be approved by 8pm ET'); optional 'Make this a Same Day Payment' checkbox if entitled; Batch Description; Company Discretionary Data; Descriptive Date; beneficiaries from address book or 'Include multiple beneficiary on ACH payment' / 'Add Another Beneficiary'; Amount; optional Create Prenote, Hold, Addenda, Beneficiary Exclusion Dates; optionally 'Save this payment as a template' (Template Code, Restrict); Submit (for approval) or Save for Later (Incomplete). Alternatively import a NACHA file (Import In Process / Needs Repair statuses) or use 'Payment templates' > 'Copy as Payment'.

moments.title: 'All payments must be approved before they will be released to the bank…
moments.customer_action: 'All payments must be approved before they will be released to the bank for processing. Approval requirements are based on your configuration and each [user's] permissions.' Approver opens the 'Payments Requiring Approval' pre-defined view (statuses Entered, Modified, Incomplete Approval, High Value) and clicks Approve in the Actions column (bulk approve via checkboxes; Unapprove available before extraction); alert 'Payments Awaiting My Approval' fires only for eligible approvers who are not the creator (dual-approval workflow); approvals also possible in the Truist One View mobile app.

moments.title: Submitted = Entered; fully approved = Approved; extracted at the next…
moments.action: Submitted = Entered; fully approved = Approved; extracted at the next window (Origination 7/9/11 am, 2/4/6/8/9 pm ET; Same-Day 7/9/11 am, 2 pm ET; future-dated extracted 2 days before value date) → Released; other statuses: Approval Window Passed, Rejected (by approver), Balance Check Failure (retries until cutoff). Alerts: ACH Payment Released, Transactions Processing Status Changed, Approval Window Passed, Balance Check, Payment Cutoff Time Warning; returns/NOCs via reporting.
